title: Normative Common Ground Replication (NormCoRe): Replication-by-Translation for Studying Norms in Multi-agent AI

bias_targets.methodology: Varying the language used to instantiate AI agent personas (English, Mandarin, Spanish) and analyzing the resulting shifts in individual preferences and group consensus regarding distributive justice principles.
Comparing the normative fairness judgments and distributive justice preferences of AI agent groups generated by U.S. foundation model ecosystems versus Chinese foundation model ecosystems.
